uncapped_liability.basis: Industry claims data for uncapped liability disputes (CUAD benchmark)

unlimited_indemnification.basis: Average indemnification claim settlement, enterprise SaaS/services

unilateral_termination.basis: Lost revenue / wind-down cost on early termination for convenience

auto_renewal.basis: Unintended renewal cost over one additional term

non_compete.basis: Opportunity cost / litigation over restraint enforceability

exclusivity.basis: Foregone channel revenue under exclusive dealing

ip_assignment.basis: Valuation of assigned IP / loss of background rights

governing_law.basis: Incremental cost of litigating in an unfavorable forum

liquidated_damages.basis: Accrued liquidated damages exposure on milestone delay

warranty_disclaimer.basis: Uncovered defect / remediation cost under as-is delivery

audit_rights.basis: Audit true-up and compliance remediation cost

assignment_restriction.basis: Deal-blocking / consent cost on change of control

payment_terms_risk.basis: Working-capital and late-fee exposure on extended terms

force_majeure_gap.basis: Non-excused non-performance loss during a disruption event
